h1_vs_e0_attribution.mechanism_explanation: H1 and E0 admit the exact same signal event IDs (34 for W1_C04, 55 for W2_C05) with identical 30/28 cooldown-skipped conflicts and zero fold-censor differences. 100% of the H1-E0 bps difference is a fixed-event horizon extension effect on trades that hit the 12h TIME_CAP in E0; account-vs-paired bps difference is 0.000000 bps for H1 (only USDT sizing scales when cash < 1000 during drawdowns). However, all simultaneous 7d/14d 95% block-bootstrap CIs span zero, so H1 is NOT statistically proven.
